description: Search DOJ’s current list page or its August 2025 announcement by name; defaults to the current page. “Sanctuary jurisdictions” is DOJ’s label, not a finding by MORVS. The two DOJ pages differ; removed entries carry DOJ’s linked release and stated reason. A county-level 287(g) agreement and a state-level designation can both be true; no conclusion is drawn from the two records. A non-match says only that a name was not found on the selected DOJ page; DOJ says its list is not exhaustive.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive jurisdiction name substring, at most 80 characters.

version.description: DOJ list version: current list page (default) or original announcement.

name: sanctuary_doj_list
title: Find DOJ Sanctuary List Entries
